original:
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ।
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ॥
sanskrit:
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ।
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ॥
transliteration:
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayam udīrayet ||
translation: Having bowed down to Narayana and to Nara, the foremost of male beings, and to the goddess Sarasvati, and to Vyasa, let the word 'Jaya' (Victory) be uttered.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: नारायण, नरश्रेष्ठ नर, भगवती सरस्वती और महर्षि व्यास को नमस्कार कर 'जय' (महाभारत) का पाठ करना चाहिए।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: नारायण, नरश्रेष्ठ नर, भगवती सरस्वती आणि महर्षी व्यास यांना नमस्कार करून 'जय' (महाभारत) ग्रंथाचे वाचन करावे.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: Nilakantha's Bharatabhavadipa explains that 'Jaya' is the esoteric name of this great itihasa, symbolizing the triumph of the Supreme Self over ignorance and mortality.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: This auspicious mangalacharana verse invokes the divine lineage and inaugurates the sacred narrative recited by Ugrasrava Sauti before Shaunaka in Naimisharanya.

original:
धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च मोक्षे च भरतर्षभ ।
यदिहास्ति तदन्यत्र यन्नेहास्ति न तत् क्वचित् ॥
sanskrit:
धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च मोक्षे च भरतर्षभ ।
यदिहास्ति तदन्यत्र यन्नेहास्ति न तत् क्वचित् ॥
transliteration:
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha |
yad ihāsti tad anyatra yan nehāsti na tat kvacit ||
translation: Whatever is found here concerning Dharma, Artha, Kama, and Moksha, may be found elsewhere; but what is not found here is found nowhere else.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष के विषय में जो कुछ इस ग्रंथ में है, वही अन्यत्र है; जो यहाँ नहीं है, वह कहीं भी नहीं है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: धर्म, अर्थ, काम आणि मोक्ष या चार पुरुषार्थांच्या बाबतीत जे काही या ग्रंथात आहे तेच इतरत्र आढळते; जे येथे नाही ते कुठेही नाही.

layers.author: bori
layers.content: The famous encyclopedic aphorism of the Mahabharata, highlighting its universal scope covering the entirety of human existence and spiritual liberation.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: The sage asserts that all aspects of human civilization, statecraft, ethics, and metaphysics are comprehensively analyzed within this epic.
